identity.name: Luminor Marina 1950 3 Days Automatic
identity.one_liner: Panerai's 44mm steel Luminor Marina, running the automatic in-house P.9010 movement behind the brand's crown-protecting bridge.

narrative.story: Panerai supplied dive instruments and radium-luminous watches to Italian Navy frogmen from the 1930s through 1956, developing the crown-protecting bridge and cushion case that still define the Luminor line. PAM01312 is a modern civilian-market Luminor Marina built around Panerai's in-house automatic P.9010 movement, distinct from the historical Navy-issue pieces its design draws on.
